1.w: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:

2.w: “Does a wise one answer [with] knowledge of wind, and fill his belly [with] the east wind?

3.w: Should he reason with a word that does not benefit, and with words without profit in them?

4.w: Indeed, you break apart fear, and diminish meditation before the face of God.

5.w: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the tongue of the crafty.

6.w: Your own mouth declares you wicked, and not I; and your lips testify against you.

7.w: Were you born [as] the first man? And were you formed before the face of the hills?

8.w: Do you listen in the council of God, and reduce to yourself wisdom?

9.w: What do you know that we do not know? [What] do you understand that [is] not with us?

10.w: Even the gray-haired and the aged are with us—greater than your father [in] days.

11.w: Are the consolations of God too small for you, or a word in gentleness to you?

12.w: Why does your heart carry you away, and why do your eyes flash,

13.w: that you should turn your spirit against God, and bring out [such] words out of your mouth?

14.w: What [is] man that he should be pure, or that he should be righteous, one born of woman?

15.w: Behold, He does not trust in His holy ones, and the heavens are not pure in His eyes;

16.w: also surely the abominable and corrupt one [is] a man drinking iniquity like water!

17.w: I will tell you! Listen to me, and this [that] I have seen I will recount—

18.w: what the wise have brought forward and have not concealed from their fathers,

19.w: to whom alone the land was given, and a stranger did not pass over in their midst.

20.w: All the days of the wicked, he is writhing, and the number of years is hidden for the ruthless.

21.w: The voice of dread [is] in his ears; in prosperity, the destroyer comes upon him.

22.w: He is not sure to return from darkness, and he [is] watched over unto the sword.

23.w: He [is] is wandering for bread for vultures, knowing that a day of darkness [is] ready at his hand.

24.w: Distress and anguish terrify him; they prevail against him like a king ready for the attack.

25.w: For he stretched out his hand against God, and against Shaddai he sought to prevail,

26.w: running against Him with the neck, [with] thickness of the bosses of his shields.

27.w: For he has covered his face with his fat, and made thick fat upon [his] loin.

28.w: And he dwells in desolate cities, houses in which they do not dwell, which are ready to be heaps.

29.w: He will not be rich, and his wealth will not stand, nor will [his] possessions stretch out over the earth.

30.w: He will not turn aside from darkness; the flame will dry out his shoot, and he will turn aside at the breath of His mouth.

31.w: Do not let him trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his recompense.

32.w: Not in his day will it be fulfilled, and his branch will not be green.

33.w: He will shake off his unripe grape like a vine, and he will cast off his blossom like an olive tree.

34.w: For the company of the godless [is] barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

35.w: They conceive trouble and give birth to inquity, and their belly prepares deceit.”
